tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: When the Archivist considers it to be in the public interest the Archivist may accept for deposit—

children.text: the papers and other historical materials of a President or former President of the United States, or other official or former official of the Government, and other papers relating to and contemporary with a President or former President of the United States, subject to restrictions agreeable to the Archivist as to their use; and

recorded information (as such term is defined in section 3301(a)(2) of this title) from private sources that are appropriate for preservation by the Government as evidence of its organization, functions, policies, decisions, procedures, and transactions.

tree.heading: Exception.—
tree.text: This section shall not apply in the case of any Presidential records which are subject to the provisions of chapter 22 of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2111 was renumbered section 2115 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–187 amended section generally, substituting subsecs. (a) and (b) for similar provisions contained in pars. (1) and (2) and concluding provisions. 1984—Pub. L. 98–497, § 107(a)(5), substituted “Archivist” for “Administrator of General Services” in provisions preceding par. (1), and substituted “Archivist” for “Administrator” in par. (1). 1978—Pub. L. 95–591 inserted provision excluding Presidential records which are subject to provisions of chapter 22 of this title from application of this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1984 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 98–497 effective Apr. 1, 1985, see section 301 of Pub. L. 98–497, set out as a note under section 2102 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1978 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 95–591 effective with respect to Presidential records created during a term of office of President beginning on or after Jan. 20, 1981, see section 3 of Pub. L. 95–591, set out as an Effective Date note under section 2201 of this title.
